entities.name: DRB Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for releasing Data Radio Bearers (DRBs) in UE configuration. Involves releasing PDCP entities, SDAP entities, and indicating releases to upper layers.

entities.name: DRB Establishment Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing Data Radio Bearers (DRBs) in UE configuration. Involves establishing PDCP entities, configuring security, and setting up SDAP entities.

entities.name: drb-ToReleaseList
entities.description: List of DRB identities to be released from current UE configuration.

entities.name: drb-ToAddModList
entities.description: List of DRB identities to be added or modified in current UE configuration.

entities.name: PDCP Entity
entities.description: Packet Data Convergence Protocol entity responsible for ciphering, integrity protection, and header compression for DRBs.

entities.name: SDAP Entity
entities.description: Service Data Adaptation Protocol entity that maps QoS flows to DRBs and handles QoS flow management.

entities.name: eps-BearerIdentity
entities.description: EPS bearer identity associated with a DRB for interworking with E-UTRAN.

entities.name: cipheringDisabled
entities.description: Condition indicating whether ciphering is disabled for a PDCP entity.

entities.name: integrityProtection
entities.description: Condition indicating whether integrity protection is configured for a PDCP entity.

entities.name: reestablishPDCP
entities.description: Flag indicating whether PDCP entity should be re-established during reconfiguration.

entities.name: recoverPDCP
entities.description: Flag indicating whether PDCP entity should perform data recovery during reconfiguration.

entities.name: DAPS bearer
entities.description: Dual Active Protocol Stack bearer that maintains connections to both source and target cells during handover.

relations.description: DRB release procedure operates on DRB identities listed in drb-ToReleaseList
DRB release procedure includes releasing the PDCP entity
DRB release procedure includes indicating release to SDAP entity when configured
DRB establishment procedure operates on DRB identities listed in drb-ToAddModList
DRB establishment procedure includes establishing and configuring PDCP entity
DRB establishment procedure includes establishing and configuring SDAP entity when sdap-Config is included
PDCP entity ciphering configuration depends on cipheringDisabled condition
PDCP entity integrity protection configuration depends on integrityProtection condition
When reestablishPDCP is set, the PDCP entity is re-established with new security configuration
When recoverPDCP is set, the PDCP entity performs data recovery
DAPS bearer configuration requires specific PDCP entity configuration for target cell group
DRB release procedure includes indicating release of eps-BearerIdentity to upper layers when applicable
DRB establishment procedure includes associating DRB with eps-BearerIdentity and indicating establishment to upper layers
